verdict.rationale: Docs show per-app pages listing tool counts (e.g., '46 actions · 4 triggers'), dedicated MCP servers per app, transport details (SSE/streamable HTTP), and connection headers/hosting endpoint — enough for a developer to get a sense of what's available before connecting. However, no evidence shows actual input schemas for individual tools or a registry browsing UI that surfaces per-tool argument details. Missing for 10: documented input schemas per tool, a searchable registry listing with schema previews, independent confirmation of pre-connection inspection workflow.
